policy: Reuse the frozen Round9 final derivation, including original-size supplements and all previous exact-render disputes, for exact input/request/criteria/output keys. Do not reintroduce its tentative contact-sheet uncertainty as a new conflicting final assessment. Historical unresolved conflicts remain uncertain; new unique renders require direct anonymous review. Inherited final uncertainty is not regraded on new contact sheets.
implementation: functional_v10.finalize_review prefers Round9 final for covered keys; earlier raw history remains for uncovered keys
functional_v10.development_full_review exports only newly assessed uncertain images, not inherited final uncertainty
